g.text: PROMISES TO PAY THE BEARER ON DEMAND
THE VALUE OF TWO HUNDRED GRID

GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID GRID CREATIVE RESERVE · 200 GRID · COMMON GROUND · 200 GRID
Empathy is the value of standing somewhere else. The 200 note inverts the GRID itself in a circle: the same lines,
now seen from another point. Two perspectives, left and right, share exactly one point of contact, and every
circle that crosses between them does so at a right angle. Understanding is geometry, not decoration.
Left and right families, all tangent at P, radii C0 / k: a harmonic series.
Grid lines become circles through P. The mark is the grid seen from another point.
The vertical pencil circles cross each disc; every lens is a flat multiply ink.
Lines through P invert to themselves: the hairline fan aims every crescent at P.
The denomination stands in its own column, read from the side, like a spine.
A grid, and a vertex P
A line y = a becomes a circle
through P, tangent to the axis.
Left and right of P: two
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE
